goal: Declare a flywheel[postgres] optional extra (psycopg, psycopg_pool) in pyproject.toml and add testcontainers to the dev group.

constraints: Add [project.optional-dependencies] with a 'postgres' key listing 'psycopg' and 'psycopg_pool' (or 'psycopg[binary]' if needed for the platform -- implementer's call).
Add 'testcontainers' to the existing [dependency-groups] dev list, not to the postgres extra.
Do not move existing runtime dependencies into the extra.
Run `uv lock` so uv.lock reflects the new deps; commit the lockfile alongside pyproject.toml.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (e.g. 'chore:' or 'build:') before reporting verify.
non_goals: Do not import psycopg from any flywheel module in this task.
Do not create the schema file or PostgresStore module.

graders.run: grep -q psycopg pyproject.toml && grep -q psycopg_pool pyproject.toml
graders.name: psycopg-deps

graders.run: uv sync --extra postgres && uv run --extra postgres python -c 'import psycopg, psycopg_pool'
graders.name: extra-installs

graders.run: uv sync --group dev && uv run python -c 'import testcontainers'
graders.name: dev-group-installs
